owner_creation.analysis: cmd_offset: The c_int owns the byte offset at the left edge of the visible command text, initially zero; it is distinct from display-column counts.
owner_creation.invariant: Visible byte origin is not a terminal column value.
limitations: Source-specific review of coupled legacy editor state; M0-MEM-001 remains open and no new runtime defect is asserted from raw-pointer structure alone.

aliases_escapes.analysis: cmd_offset: cmd_home and scrolling derive pointers into cmdbuf from the scalar; copying the offset does not validate the selected UTF sequence or current text owner.

limitations: Source-specific review of coupled legacy editor state; M0-MEM-001 remains open and no new runtime defect is asserted from raw-pointer structure alone.

callback_targets.analysis: cmd_offset: Scroll logic calls step_char and repaint/output directly to compute a new visible origin; the integer stores no callback address.

invalidation.analysis: cmd_offset: Reset/kill sets it to zero and lshift/rshift replaces it after character stepping; later in-place edits can change what the same numeric offset denotes.
